meaning.zh:
“出其不意” 或 “制造意外”。

这个短语源自棒球运动中的曲线球（curveball），这种球的轨迹难以预测，会让击球手措手不及。在日常生活中，“throw a curveball” 用来形容某人给别人出难题或制造意外的状况，使人措手不及或打乱计划。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from baseball, where a curveball has an unpredictable trajectory that can catch the batter off guard. In everyday life, "throw a curveball" describes a situation where someone presents an unexpected problem or surprise that disrupts plans or catches others unprepared.

lines.en: The boss threw a curveball by changing the project deadline at the last minute.
lines.zh: 老板在最后一刻突然改变项目截止日期，让人措手不及。

lines.en: Just when we thought the meeting was over, he threw a curveball with a new proposal.
lines.zh: 就在我们以为会议结束时，他突然提出了一项新提议，让人措手不及。

lines.en: Life can throw you a curveball, so it's always good to have a backup plan.
lines.zh: 生活中总会有意外，因此最好准备一个备用计划。
